About this item

  • 1080P Webcam with Cover for Video Calls - EMEET computer webcam provides design and Optimization for professional video streaming. Realistic 1920 x 1080p video, 5-layer anti-glare lens, providing smooth video. C960 computer camera delivers 1920x1080 video with fixed focus (11.8–118.1 inches), so as to provide a clearer image. C960 USB webcam has a cover and can be removed automatically to meet your needs for privacy. For optimal image performance, use the webcam in a well-lit environment.
  • Built-in 2 Omnidirectional Mics - EMEET webcam with microphone for desktop features 2 built-in omnidirectional microphones, picking up your voice to create clear audio for communication. When installing the webcam, select EMEET C960 as the default microphone input device in your computer and video applications and select C960 as the default device in Zoom/Teams and ensure microphone permissions are enabled for proper use. Please note that C960 does not include built-in speakers.
  • Automatic Light Adjustment - Automatic exposure adjustment is applied in EMEET HD webcam 1080p so that the streaming webcam can deliver stable image performance. EMEET C960 camera for computer also features color adjustment and exposure optimization to help you look your best. For optimal video quality, it is recommended to use the webcam in normal or well-lit environments and select suitable video settings in your application. Proper lighting helps achieve a clearer and more balanced image.
  • Plug-and-Play & Upgraded USB Connectivity - New C960 webcam features both USB Type-A & A-to-C adapter connections for wider compatibility. For stable performance, connect the webcam directly to the computer's main USB port and ensure the device is recognized correctly. If a hub or docking station is used, please ensure it provides sufficient power and stable data transmission, as limited ports may affect performance. 90° wide-angle lens captures more participants without frequent adjustments.
  • High Compatibility & Multi Application - C960 webcam for laptop is compatible with Windows 10/11, macOS 10.14+, and Android TV 7.0+. Not supported: Windows Hello, TVs, tablets, or game consoles. It works with Zoom, Teams, Facetime, Google Meet, YouTube and more. Please select C960 webcam as the default camera and microphone device in your application and ensure camera/microphone permissions are enabled, especially on macOS. (Tips: Incompatible with Windows Hello)

  • Why is my webcam not working or not detected?

    Connect the EMEET C960 webcam directly to a USB port, not hubs. Enable camera/mic permissions in Windows/macOS. Select the webcam in Zoom, Teams, Facetime, or other apps. Restart apps after permission changes for proper detection.

  • Does EMEET C960 have built-in speakers?

    EMEET C960 is a webcam with built-in microphones for audio input and does not include built-in speakers. If you need speaker functionality, please choose an EMEET webcam model with built-in speakers like EMEET C980 (ASIN B0DCFGC6NJ).

  • Why is the video quality not as clear as expected?

    C960 delivers Full HD 1080P video. For clearer image quality, use the webcam in a well-lit environment and select suitable video settings in your application. Lighting and software settings may affect image performance.

  • Why is my microphone volume low or not working properly?

    C960 features two built-in omnidirectional microphones for clear voice pickup. Select EMEET C960 as the default microphone device, enable microphone permissions, and keep an appropriate distance for optimal audio performance.

  • Can I use this webcam with a USB hub or docking station?

    Yes, but connect directly to a USB port for stability. Hubs may cause intermittent video. Use the included Type-A/Type-C adapters. The upgraded USB cable and foldable design allow flexible, stable setup for streaming or calls.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    This camera is awesome
    bought this as a “just get something cheap that works” webcam… and it completely overdelivered. I’ve used it for Zoom calls, Teams meetings, and even a couple YouTube recordings — and every single time someone asks, “Wait, what camera are you using?” That’s when you know it’s good. The video quality is shockingly crisp for the price. It’s true 1080p, not that blurry, washed-out “technically HD” look. Even in less-than-perfect lighting, it still makes you look clear and professional (huge win if you’re working from home like me). But what really surprised me? The microphone. Most built-in webcam mics sound like you’re talking through a tunnel. This one doesn’t. The dual mics actually pick up your voice cleanly without making you sound robotic or distant. I stopped using my separate mic for casual calls because this one is just… easier. Other things I didn’t expect to love: • Plug & play = literally 10 seconds to set up • Works with EVERYTHING (Zoom, Teams, FaceTime, Google Meet, even my Switch) • Wide enough angle without making your face look distorted • Comes with USB-A AND USB-C option (no adapter hunting) • Stays securely mounted — no awkward slipping mid-call Is it a $200 professional camera? No. But here’s the thing — for 95% of people, you don’t need that. This does the job extremely well without overcomplicating anything. If you’re upgrading from a laptop camera or an older webcam, this will feel like a massive glow-up overnight. Simple. Clean. Reliable. Way better than it has any right to be at this price. Highly recommend.

      4 out of 5 stars
      Great Webcam for the Price (Occasional Brief Blur)
      Reviewed in the United States on March 6, 2026
      Style: 1080P Updated
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Overall I’m very happy with this webcam for everyday video calls and meetings. The setup was incredibly easy—just plug it in and it works right away without installing anything. The video quality is clear and the wide viewing angle is great for Zoom, Teams, and other calls. It’s a solid upgrade from the built-in laptop camera.

      The microphone also works well. People can hear me clearly without needing a separate mic, which makes it convenient for quick meetings and calls. The privacy cover is a nice extra feature too.

      The only small issue I’ve noticed is that the video occasionally goes blurry for a second and then refocuses. It doesn’t happen often and it corrects itself quickly, but it’s something I’ve noticed during longer calls. The camera uses a fixed-focus lens designed to keep objects within a certain range sharp, which generally works well for normal desk distance. ￼

      Even with that minor quirk, it’s still a great value for the price and works perfectly for everyday work calls, virtual meetings, and online chats. If you want an affordable, simple webcam that’s easy to use, this one gets the job done.

      Helpful tip: Make sure the webcam is plugged directly into your computer rather than a USB hub—this can help keep the video feed stable.
